name: Highborne
feature: You carry yourself with authority. Gain +1 to Presence when interacting with the upper class.

name: Loreborne
feature: You have access to academic networks. Gain +1 to Knowledge when researching or recalling lore.

name: Orderborne
description: Raised within structured institutions like temples or militias.
feature: You understand hierarchy and protocol. Allies gain +1 to morale when you lead.

name: Ridgeborne
feature: Hardy and sure-footed. Ignore difficult terrain in mountains and high altitude effects.

name: Seaborne
description: Raised on ships and coastal towns.
feature: At home on the water. Gain +1 to Agility on ships and when swimming.

name: Slyborne
description: Raised in the shadows of cities.
feature: You know the back alleys and hidden routes. Gain +1 to Finesse when moving unseen in urban areas.

name: Underborne
feature: Darkvision and an innate sense of direction underground. Never lost in caves or tunnels.

name: Wildborne
feature: You read the land like a book. Gain +1 to Instinct when foraging, hunting, or navigating wild terrain.
